newsitem.title: UK: Pressac to buy Italamec, raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Pressac to buy Italamec, raise capital.

text.p: Pressac Holdings Plc said on Thursday it planned to buy Italian automotive components supplier Italamec Srl for a maximum 54.246 billion lire, funded by a one-for-three rights issue at 180p per new share.
Pressac, a maker of electro-mechanical and lighting products, said the issue would raise approximately 21 million stg net of expenses.
It estimated the sterling cost of privately-owned Italamec at 21.8 million stg.
Pressac said Baring Brothers International Ltd would underwrite the rights issue. The brokers are Swiss Bank Corporation, acting through its division SBC Warburg.
It said the acquisition was conditional on Pressac shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting in January and the rights issue proceeding.
Pressac said Italamec's profit before tax totalled 3.4 million pounds in the first 10 months of this year on turnover of 23.8 million.
